messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy to staging attempted for tag v2.13.0-rc3 (commit 9a3f5b2). CI gate failed: 2 checks failing — integration-tests, smoke-db-migration. Full run: https://ci.internal/runs/55321 :warning:
marie (release-lead): Noted. Holding the release window. Can someone triage the integration failure? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam (backend): I'll take integration-tests. Pulling the run now and rerunning locally. Will report back in ~15m.
priya (qa): From the CI logs the failing test is 'payment_session_expiry::should_redirect_after_timeout' — looks like session expiry timing flake. I can reproduce locally with the test harness.
sam (backend): Repro steps from my side gave a different failure — stack shows db deadlock during migration run. Pasting the failing snippet:
```
FAILED: smoke-db-migration
ERROR: PG::LockNotAvailable: could not obtain lock on relation "user_sessions"
  /usr/local/bundle/gems/pg-1.2.3/lib/pg.rb:56:in `exec'
  app/db/migrate/20260203_add_session_index.rb:17:in `change'
```
oliver (sre): That lock conflict usually happens when two migration jobs overlap. CI migration job should run in serial. Is the runner parallelizing migrations? I can check the runner config.
deploy-bot: CI rerun queued (rerun_id=55321-2). Waiting for results.
marie (release-lead): If migration is flaky we can't promote rc3. Options: a) rollback the migration in the branch and redeploy rc3 b) pin canary to v2.12.9 and continue other staged rollouts c) manually unblock after triage (not preferred). Thoughts?
priya (qa): Given the session timing flake and DB lock both present, I'd prefer pinning. We should avoid manual unblocks unless urgent.
sam (backend): Agree. I can back out the migration in a hotfix branch but that'd need a quick smoke run. If we pin canary we buy time to fix in parallel.
oliver (sre): I dug into runner config — a recent change to the staging runner enabled parallel matrix for jobs. I'll flip the migrations job to 'run: sequential' for staging and trigger a separate CI rerun. That should address the lock.
deploy-bot: Rerun complete: integration-tests still failing (1 test), smoke-db-migration succeeded on retry. See https://ci.internal/runs/55321-2
priya (qa): Re-running the flaky test with increased timeout passes locally. It looks like a timing-sensitive assertion. I can PR a small test fix to relax the timing window.
marie (release-lead): Decision: hold rc3 for now. Pin canary to v2.12.9 for production canary traffic. sam/priya/oliver — please coordinate fixes in the rc3 branch. When integration-tests are stable and migration config is confirmed sequential, we can reattempt a new rc.
sam (backend): Copy. Opening PR to revert migration + separate patch for test timeout. Will tag for quick CI.
priya (qa): I'll add the test change and run the local harness, then assign reviewers.
oliver (sre): Changed runner: migrations now serial on staging. Monitoring CI runs for next hour.
marie (release-lead): Thanks all. I'll update the release notes and slack release channel about pinning. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Note: deploy to staging blocked by CI gate for tag v2.13.0-rc3 (commit 9a3f5b2). Manual unblock requested? no -> set to false. If you want to force, use `/deploy unblock 1845006789 reason` (requires release-lead + eng-sre approval).
marie (release-lead): No force unblock. We'll wait for fixes.
sam (backend): ETA for PRs ~30-45m. I'll post when CI green.
priya (qa): I'll run a focused regression suite once PRs land.
marie (release-lead): Closing loop here. We'll reconvene when CI passes.
